workload_meetings_limits_008.evidence: Internal meetings shall be held to a minimum to allow maximum preparation time by teachers. ... teachers may be required to attend two (2) activities each semester outside the regular working day.

workload_nonteaching_duties_009.evidence: If said activity involves the control and supervision of students, the assignments shall be fairly and equitably distributed among the entire staff. All other non-voluntary activities outside the regular school day which involve the supervision of students will qualify the teacher for compensatory time or satisfactory supplemental compensation.
